test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series, will complete the series.

C_D_DD_ _DC_D
solution:
Given : C_D_DD_ _DC_D

By checking options :

Option 1) DDCCD → C__D__D__D__DD__C__ __C__DC__D__D → (It doesn't Follow the pattern) 

Option 2) DCCDD → C__**D**__D__**C**__DD__**C**__ __**D**__DC__**D**__D → (It follows the pattern of: CDD - CDD - CDD - CDD)

Option 3) CCDCC → C__C__D__C__DD__D__ __C__DC__C__D → (It doesn't Follow the pattern)

Option 4) DCDCD → C__D__D__C__DD__D__ __C__DC__D__D → (It doesn't Follow the pattern)

So, out of all the options "Option - (2)" follows the pattern.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
